rewrites.comment: Client-side routing. TanStack Router owns /fleet/board and the rest, so a cold load or a refresh on any route has to be served index.html. Vercel checks the filesystem BEFORE applying rewrites, so real files — /assets/*, /favicon.svg — still win and never reach this rule.

headers.comment: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so a changed file is a changed URL and a year of caching is safe.
Not fingerprinted, so it gets an hour rather than a year.
